evidenceProvenance: Run excerpts are transcribed from retained exec_command/write_stdin tool output for these fresh reconstruction runs. Leading/trailing blank lines are normalized. capturedOutputSHA256 hashes the included UTF-8 excerpt, not an independently archived complete terminal log. No pre-reset output is included. Vitest reported start times are retained without inferring a date or timezone.
fileIdentityScope: SHA-256 of the exact raw bytes of the 13 frozen presentation package files, captured after development runs. This is not a full-source digest, build fingerprint, or an assertion that every run executed this final file set unchanged.

distinctPassedCases.aggregationNote: Distinct passing cases across overlapping development runs; do not sum run pass counts as independent tests or present these as one combined gate.

review.scope: Timing/reset/Hermite and PresentedFrame integration, including coherent positive spans <=0.5 s, unchanged contact states, finite acceleration <=120 m/s², exact held endpoints, rider reset clocks, tire/service boundaries and O.BODY continuous sampling. No review test jobs or edits.

limitations: Rendering tests use production geometry and transforms with a no-op drawing context; they do not establish rendered-image quality or hardware frame rate.
Hermite and teleport guards are presentation heuristics; wheel whole-turn inference depends on recorded endpoint angular velocities.
Old test and benchmark results from the environment lost before publication do not certify this reconstructed source.
